verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a sanctioned third-party rail for Ohio Secretary of State filings: there is nothing on designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives acting for a company. The only related item is a mention of 'Filing Administrator functions' in the Ohio Business Gateway. That is an internal account-administration role, not a documented provider-delegation channel, so it earns no credit, and the ohiosos.gov surfaces were walled at robots.txt and never read.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
